errors_encountered.fix: Copy evaluated csproj Include/Link files before namespace rewriting and triage.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Manual reconstruction split source shell/helpers across inconsistent namespaces and duplicate locations after linked shared files were omitted.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The bootstrap did not apply the documented Windows.UI.Colors namespace mapping.

errors_encountered.fix: Raise TargetPlatformMinVersion and manifest MinVersion together, or guard optional APIs.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Device-dependent initialization ran without an exception boundary on a machine where tethering was unavailable.
errors_encountered.fix: Catch initialization failure and present status while retaining the original controls.

errors_encountered.error: CS2001 missing *.g.i.cs and contradictory launch results

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Bootstrap and both self-checks raced the scaffold/bootstrap and returned Target not found/False.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent used the bootstrap result after it eventually completed.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Follow the existing mandatory sequential Step 0 gate.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The first build emitted 13 errors; the agent manually rebuilt shared XAML/shell structure and retried color mapping.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Project-linked shared files were absent from bootstrap output and one documented namespace mapping was not automated.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent manually created linked XAML equivalents, consolidated helpers, and changed color references.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Make bootstrap honor Include/Link metadata and apply safe namespace rewrites.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Launch was unavailable, then crashed; shell chrome was removed speculatively; concurrent final commands produced transient generated-file errors.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 3 launch attempts, 2 validator runs, and 1 speculative shell rewrite
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Launch layout assumptions, unavailable-device initialization, and concurrent output-tree access obscured diagnosis.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: A serialized validator rebuild/launch passed after initialization was guarded and the platform minimum was reconciled.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Support default dotnet output layouts, preserve controls in defensive UI, reconcile API contracts, and serialize lifecycle commands.
